title: Finland temporarily restricts air, sea traffic again over drone risk
sourceName: Daily Finland, reporting Finnish Defence Forces statements
description: The Finnish Defence Forces imposed air and maritime restrictions in the eastern Gulf of Finland on 14 August and lifted the restrictions that morning.
provenance: Real article inspected on 2026-09-08. Paraphrased assessment; source date retained at day precision. This August event is unrelated to the September Porvoo recovery.
